policy.GET: actual apiClient: initial + 3 retries with seeded jitter
policy.POST: actual SyncDraft; app.js wrapper: initial + 3 exact retries after 4/8/16 seconds; terminal errors stop
policy.patient: --patient adds actual patientRetry to GET and SyncDraft delivery: up to 32 attempts within a 120s retry window with seeded jitter
policy.clock: virtual, fixed per-WebDAV-call delay; no real RTT/throughput/CPU/bandwidth/browser rendering model
policy.sessions: pre-opened editor sessions; 50 reader/10 editor tasks per round; synchronized or seeded 10s arrival spread; rounds are barrier-separated waves; later waves manually retry retained drafts with a fresh retry budget, not automatic continuous arrivals
policy.vault: in-memory DraftVault substitute; IndexedDB/browser behavior covered separately by browser CI
